account: Researchers at IIIT Bangalore describe a machine-learning pipeline that detects necrosis in meningioma images under limited-data conditions. The ITU account cites a 2019 presentation of the work by the same lead author at the IEEE SPS Winter School in Bangalore. It names the Neuropathology Lab at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS), Bangalore, as its partner in the work. The pipeline runs on university servers, and the team presents it as promising research in computational neuropathology. The account names Adaboost and logistic regression as the best models and gives no accuracy figures. No source reports an improvement in deployment or an effect on diagnosis. No source reports an outcome for a patient.
